note: Zambia: a business visitor staying beyond thirty days takes the Temporary Employment Permit, up to six months in twelve; employment beyond six months the Employment Permit, applied for by the employer while the worker stays outside Zambia. Whether a performer's stay of thirty days or less needs neither isn't stated, so no days are modelled.

sources.title: Department of Immigration (Zambia), Permit Types
sources.said: An Employment Permit is issued to a foreigner who enters the country to take up employment for a period exceeding six (06) months. ... A Temporary Employment Permit is issued to any business visitor who intends to remain in Zambia for a period exceeding thirty (30) days. The validity of the permit should not exceed six (6) months within a period of twelve (12) months.
